accessibility.title: Internal Forces module introduction static overview
accessibility.long_description: A text-first overview of Internal Forces. Expose and interpret normal force, shear force, bending moment, and torque at a section using a consistent cut-face sign convention and equilibrium of an isolated segment.

objective: Expose and interpret normal force, shear force, bending moment, and torque at a section using a consistent cut-face sign convention and equilibrium of an isolated segment.
prerequisites: Use complete external free-body diagrams, support reactions, rigid-body equilibrium, section cuts, moment sense, and force-component conventions.

worked_example.entry_description: Move a cut through a loaded member, isolate one side, and reveal the N-V-M-T resultants required for equilibrium under the declared cut-face sign convention.

diagram_description: The planned beam section cut and internal-resultant workspace will support: drag a section cut along a member; choose left or right isolated segment; toggle cut-face sign convention; show normal-force arrow; show shear-force arrow; show bending-moment couple; show torque couple; update internal resultants from segment equilibrium. Until v1.1.0 is published, this description and procedure map are the complete accessible fallback.
